SLOPPY JOE BUNS RECIPE BELOW Ingredients DOUGH 250 ml lukewarm milk (1 cup) 15 g honey (1 tbsp) 7 g instant yeast (1 tbsp) 1 large egg 45 g unsalted butter, room temperature (3 tbsp, 1/2 stick) 500 g all-purpose flour (4 cups) 8 g fine salt (1⅓ tsp) SLOPPY JOE FILLING 25 ml olive oil (2 tbsp) 600 g ground beef (1⅓ lb) 4 g fine salt (⅔ tsp) 3 g paprika (1 tsp) 2 g garlic powder (⅔ tsp) 3 g onion powder (1 tsp) 3 g cayenne pepper (1 tsp) 1.5 g black pepper (½ tsp) 100 g ketchup (6 tbsps) EXTRA cheese slices (American or cheddar) Big Mac-style burger sauce 1 egg, beaten Sesame seeds Instructions Prepare all the ingredients. In a large bowl, combine the lukewarm milk, honey and yeast. Stir well and let the mixture rest for 5 minutes. Add the egg and butter and mix well. Add the flour and salt. Knead the dough for 10-12 minutes until smooth. Cover the bowl and let the dough rise in a warm spot for 1 hour, or until doubled in size. Heat the olive oil in a skillet over medium-high heat. Add the ground beef, salt, paprika, garlic powder, onion powder, cayenne pepper and black pepper. Cook for 7-8 minutes, until browned and cooked through. Add the ketchup. Stir the ketchup into the beef until well combined. Let the filling cool completely before adding it to the dough. Deflate the risen dough and divide it into 9 equal pieces. Shape each piece into a ball. Roll each dough ball into a round sheet. Place a slice of cheese in the center of each disc, then top with some of the beef filling and a spoonful of burger sauce. Add extra cheese if you like. Fold the dough inwards and pinch it tightly closed. Place the buns seam side down on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper. Brush with the beaten egg and sprinkle with sesame seeds. Let rise for 30 minutes. Bake in a preheated oven at 200°C (400°F) for 12-18 minutes, or until golden brown. #food #sloppyjoe #beef #cheese #tiktokfood

New York Times Top 50 Recipes of 2025 | Smashed Beef Kabob with Cucumber Yogurt @nytcooking @zaynab_issa - 2 cups Greek yogurt - 2 mini cucumbers - 3 tbsp mint - 1 large garlic clove - 1 pound ground beef (80/20) - 1 small yellow onion - ½ tsp ground turmeric - 2 tsp salt - black pepper - ¼ cup walnut halves - 2 tbsp cranberries - Pomegranate molasses, optional, for serving - Warmed pita or white rice, for serving Combine the yogurt, cucumbers, chopped mint, and garlic in a medium bowl, mix well, and chill until ready to serve. In a separate bowl, thoroughly mix the beef, onion, turmeric, 1 teaspoon of salt, and plenty of black pepper. Heat a large, well-seasoned cast-iron skillet over medium-high until very hot, then drop the beef into the pan in large, irregular chunks, cooking undisturbed for 6 to 8 minutes until charred and crisp on the bottom. Toss the meat with a wooden spoon to break up any extra-large pieces, then stir in the walnuts and raisins, cooking for another 2 to 3 minutes until the meat is done and the walnuts are toasted. Finally, season the chilled yogurt with the remaining 1 teaspoon of salt, spread it across the bottom of a serving platter, layer the crispy meat on top, and finish with a drizzle of optional pomegranate molasses, fresh mint leaves, and a side of warmed pita or rice. #kabob #FoodTok #nyt #cooking #beef

Roux: ½ cup butter (113g) ½ cup flour (60g) 3 garlic cloves 1 chicken bouillon cube, grated Salt to taste 1 tsp black pepper 1 tsp smoked paprika Melt the butter, add the garlic and cook for 30 seconds. Put it into a baking dish and cover the top with extra cheese… measure that with your eyes 😂 Bake at 375°F for 15 minutes, then broil on high for 3 minutes. Plate it up and finish with freshly grated Parmesan. 🧀

GROUND BEEF BULGOGI A quick, savory Korean‑inspired beef bowl that’s perfect for weeknights. INGREDIENTS Main 1 lb ground beef 1 onion, sliced 1 tbsp minced garlic Oil, for cooking Sesame oil, for finishing Sesame seeds, garnish Chopped scallion, garnish Kimchi or radish kimchi, for serving Sauce 2 tbsp brown sugar 2 tbsp mirin 4 tbsp soy sauce (low sodium preferred) 1 tbsp Korean plum syrup* *Sub: 1 tbsp water + 1 tsp apple cider vinegar INSTRUCTIONS 1. Peel and slice the onion; set aside. 2. Combine brown sugar, mirin, soy sauce, and plum syrup (or substitute). Mix well and set aside. 3. Heat a little oil in a pan. Add sliced onions and cook for 1 minute. Add minced garlic and cook for another minute until fragrant. 4. Add ground beef and break it into small pieces. Once the beef is about 30% cooked, pour in the sauce. Let it simmer until the sauce reduces and evaporates — stir occasionally. (This part takes a little time, but it’s worth it.) 5. Drizzle with sesame oil and give it a final mix. 6. Assemble your bowl with rice, scallions, sesame seeds, and kimchi/ veggie of choice. Enjoy!

Chocolate Cake with Whipped Chocolate Ganache 🍫✨ DRY Ingredients: 200g (1c) white granulated sugar  120g (1c) all purpose flour  35g (1/3c) cocoa powder  1 tsp baking soda 1/2 tsp baking powder  1/2 tsp coffee powder  1 tsp salt WET Ingredients:  120g (1/2c) warm water  120g (1/2c) buttermilk  60g (1/4c) vegetable oil  1 large egg  1 tsp vanilla  Whipped Ganache:  270g (1.5c) dark chocolate chips/ chopped compound chocolate bar  135g (1/2c + 1 tbsp) heavy cream  Instructions:  1. Preheat your oven to 300F (150C). 2. In a bowl, sift and whisk the dry ingredients together.  3. In a separate bowl whisk together all the wet ingredients until well combined.  4. Add the dry ingredients to the wet ingredients and mix gently until no streaks of flour remain. Do not overmix the batter.  5. Grease 2 pcs of 6" round pan with a little oil and line the bottom with baking paper. Divide the batter into the pans (approximately 340g-350g of batter per pan).  6. Tap the pans on the counter to release air bubbles. Then bake for 40-45 mins or until a toothpick inserted comes out clean. Cool completely before frosting.  7. To make the ganache, heat the cream in the microwave or on the stove until it just starts to bubble. then pour this over the chocolate. Mix thoroughly until all chocolate is dissolved. Cover and refrigerate. Once cold, beat the ganache using a whisk or a hand mixer until it doubles in volume and becomes lighter in color.  8. Assemble the cake and enjoy 🍫 *you can also bake this in an 8x8 inch pan for the same temperature, but start checking for doneness at 30 minutes.  #bakingtherapy #chocolatecake #bakingtiktok #cozybaking #chocolatelover

Recipe Name Cheesy Crunchy Beef Tacos Ingredients 1. 1 lb (450 g) ground beef 2. 8 hard taco shells 3. 1 tbsp olive oil 4. 1 small onion, diced 5. 2 garlic cloves, minced 6. 1 packet (1 oz) taco seasoning 7. 1/2 cup water 8. 1 cup shredded cheddar cheese 9. 1/2 cup Monterey Jack cheese, shredded 10. 1/2 cup heavy cream 11. 2 oz cream cheese, softened 12. 1/2 tsp paprika 13. 1/2 tsp chili powder 14. 1/4 tsp black pepper 15. 1 diced tomato 16. 2 tbsp chopped fresh cilantro Recipe 1. Heat olive oil in a skillet over medium heat. 2. Add the onion and cook until softened, then stir in the garlic. 3. Add the ground beef and cook until browned, breaking it into crumbles. 4. Drain excess grease and mix in the taco seasoning and water. 5. Simmer for 5 minutes until the mixture thickens. 6. In a small saucepan, melt the cream cheese with the heavy cream. 7. Stir in the cheddar, Monterey Jack, paprika, chili powder, and black pepper until smooth. 8. Fill each taco shell with the seasoned beef. 9. Spoon the warm cheese sauce over the beef. 10. Top with diced tomatoes and fresh cilantro. 11. Serve immediately while the shells stay crispy. Follow for more delicious recipes!

YALL COME EAT it’s my viral sausage tortellini. 🤤  This recipe has nearly 5 million views on TikTok, so I thought it was time for an official step-by-step.  1. Cook 1 bag of tortellini according to the package directions. Drain and set aside. 2. Add 2 packs of sliced andouille sausage and cook until browned and heated through. Remove the sausage and set aside. 3. In the same skillet, add 1 small finely chopped onion and cook until softened, about 3–4 minutes. Add 2 cloves minced garlic and cook for another 30 seconds. 4. Add 8–10 halved cherry tomatoes, 2 tablespoons chopped sun-dried tomatoes and 1 tablespoon tomato paste. Stir everything together and cook for 2–3 minutes. 5. Season with 1 teaspoon oregano, 1 teaspoon basil, 1 teaspoon parsley, 1 teaspoon smoked paprika, 1 teaspoon garlic powder and 1 teaspoon onion powder. Add salt and pepper to taste. 6. Pour in 1 cup heavy cream and stir to combine. Bring the sauce to a gentle simmer, then add ½ cup shredded Parmesan cheese. Stir until the Parmesan melts and the sauce becomes creamy. 7. Add 1 cup roughly chopped spinach and stir until wilted. 8. Add the cooked tortellini and browned andouille sausage back into the skillet. Toss everything together until the tortellini and sausage are completely coated in the creamy sauce. Cook for another 1–2 minutes. 9. Garnish with red chili flakes and additional Parmesan cheese, if desired. #viralrecipe #tortellini #easydinnerideas #pastarecipe #familymeal

🤯UNBELIEVABLE SLOW COOKER BEEF This is such an easy recipe and it’s so versatile for ridiculously easy healthy meals throughout the week like these loaded sweet potato. All you need is a slow cooker, just 5 minutes of prep, and you’re good to go. You can roast sweet potato, regular potato, or serve these over quinoa, any kind of rice, or if youre lowcarb my high protein lowcarb kaizen rice. Here is how I made it: 1.Grab a slow cooker. Add 3lbs of cut chuck roast or boneless short ribs cut into about 2 inch chunks. Dont put a huge piece in! 2.To the beef add 1 thinly sliced yellow onion, 5-6 minced garlic cloves, 1 to 1.5tbsp freshly grated ginger, 1/2 cup soy or tamari sauce, 3/4 cup bone broth, 2 tbsp rice vinegar, 1 tbsp honey (or sugar free honey), 1 tsp sesame oil, and some chili flakes to taste. 3.Put the lid on and let it go for 8 hours on slow. 4.When youre read to eat, shred the beef up with a fork. 5.I roasted a large sweet potato - just put it in the oven at 350F for 75 minutes. Again, use regular rice, my kaizen lowcarb rice, quinoa, or regular potato if you wish. 6.Make a simple low calorie cucumber salad by thinly slicing 3 persian cucumbers, squeeze the juice of 1/2 lime, add 2 tbsp rice vinegar, season with salt, and add 1/2 tsp Korean or Aleppo chili flakes. Mix well. 7.Make a simple chili lime sauce by mixing 3 tbsp mayo, juice of half a lime, 1 to 1.5 tbsp sriracha sauce, 1 tbsp rice vinegar, and a pinch of salt. Mash half of the sweet potato, add some of the beef, cucumber salad, drizzle with some of the sauce and enjoy! . . . . #healthyrecipes #goodmoodfood #healthyfoodshare #lowcarb

Creamy Queso Chicken Enchiladas ​While going through my kitchen recipe index on a cozy Friday evening and thinking about my sister Gail, I decided to whip up a comforting pan of cheesy enchiladas inspired by our favorite Mexican restaurant nights, and the rich, savory aroma filling the house brought back the happiest memories. GET YOUR COOK ON with NancyG! ​Featuring tender, seasoned shredded chicken wrapped in soft flour tortillas smothered in a velvety queso blanco sauce and bubbling cheddar cheese, then topped with fresh pico de gallo, this decadent dish delivers a creamy, savory, and mouthwatering flavor experience in every single bite. ​written by NancyG The Recipe Collector ​Recipe Basics ​Yield: 5 to 6 servings ​Measurements: USA standard (rounded up) ​Ingredients & Instructions ​Ingredient List: 5 burrito size flour tortillas 3 cups shredded chicken 1 packet taco seasoning 1 cup sour cream 2 cups cheddar cheese, shredded and divided 2 tablespoons chopped green chilies 10 ounces diced tomatoes with green chilies, undrained 1 pound queso blanco Velveeta, cubed ​Detailed Instructions: ​Preheat your oven to 375°F and lightly grease a 9x13-inch baking dish. ​In a large mixing bowl, combine the shredded chicken, taco seasoning, sour cream, half of the shredded cheddar cheese, chopped green chilies, and undrained diced tomatoes with green chilies, mixing until well combined. ​Spoon an equal portion of the chicken mixture down the center of each burrito size flour tortilla, roll them up snugly, and place them seam-side down in the prepared baking dish. ​In a microwave-safe bowl, melt the cubed queso blanco Velveeta in short increments, stirring until smooth and creamy. ​Pour the warm melted queso blanco evenly over the rolled enchiladas in the baking dish, ensuring they are thoroughly coated. ​Sprinkle the remaining cheddar cheese over the top of the queso sauce. ​Bake in the preheated oven for 20 to 25 minutes until the cheese is completely melted, bubbling, and lightly golden. ​Garnish with fresh pico de gallo and chopped cilantro if desired, then let cool for 5 minutes before serving warm. ​Chef’s Notes & Nutrition ​Chef's notes by NancyG For an extra kick of heat, you can mix a handful of sliced jalapeños into the chicken filling or top the baked enchiladas with fresh diced hot peppers. You can easily substitute Monterey Jack cheese for the cheddar if you prefer an extra-melty, mild finish. ​Nutritional Facts (Per Serving): ​Calories: 610 ​Fat: 34 g ​Protein: 44 g ​Carbs: 34 g ​#TheRecipeCollector #NancyGCookOn! #fyp #Enchiladas #MexicanFood

You already know this Cowboy Mashed Potato Casserole is gonna be GOOD! 🤠 To get the recipe, click the link in @allrecipes bio or continue reading! ⬇️ Ingredients: cooking spray 6 strips bacon 2 pounds baking potatoes, peeled and chopped 1 (5 ounce) can evaporated milk or whole milk 2 tablespoons butter 1 1/2 teaspoons salt, divided 1/2 teaspoon freshly ground black pepper, divided 1 pound ground beef 1 cup chopped onion 1 green bell pepper, chopped 1 cup frozen whole kernel corn 2 cloves garlic, minced 1 1/2 teaspoons smoked paprika 1/4 cup barbecue sauce 1 tablespoon Worcestershire sauce 1 teaspoon Dijon mustard 1/2 cup shredded Cheddar or pepper Jack cheese 1/4 cup canned French fried onions 2 tablespoons finely chopped fresh parsley Directions: Gather all ingredients. Preheat the oven to 375 degrees F. Grease a 2-quart baking dish with cooking spray. Place dish on a baking sheet. Cook bacon in a large skillet over medium, turning occasionally, until crisp, about 10 minutes. Place bacon on a paper towel to drain. Drain all but 1 Tbsp of bacon fat in the skillet. Chop bacon when cool enough to handle. Meanwhile, bring a large pot of salted water to a boil. Add potatoes and return to a boil. Cook, covered, until potatoes are fork tender, 15-20 minutes. Drain potatoes. Return potatoes back to the pot along with evaporated milk, butter, 1/2 tsp salt, and 1/2 tsp pepper. Mash potatoes with a potato masher until smooth. Stir 1/4 c chopped bacon into mashed potatoes. Add ground beef, onion, and bell pepper to the skillet with reserved bacon fat. Cook over medium until meat is browned and cooked through, stirring occasionally, 8-10 minutes. Add corn kernels, garlic, and paprika to the skillet. Cook and stir for 1 minute. Stir in barbecue sauce, Worcestershire sauce, mustard, remaining 1 tsp salt, and 1/2 tsp pepper. Spread ground beef mixture in prepared baking dish. Spread potatoes evenly over beef. Sprinkle with cheese, remaining bacon, and French fried onions. Bake until bubbly and cheese is melted, 20-25 minutes. Garnish with parsley. 👨‍🍳: Nicole McLaughlin #cowboycasserole #mashedpotatoes #easydinners #dinnerideas

Grilled Gluten Recipe: 1. Mix 300g vital wheat gluten, 600g room-temp water & 1 tsp salt until no dry flour remains. Don’t overmix. 2. Transfer to a rectangular container and rest for 1 hour. 3. Drain excess water and cut into 16 pieces. 4. Gently stretch and wrap each piece around 2 chopsticks. Remove and soak in cold water. 5. Simmer over low heat until they float. Transfer to ice water. 6. Thread onto skewers and cut each piece into a spiral. 7. Spray with oil and bake at 400°F for 10 min. 8. Brush with BBQ sauce and bake at 400°F for another 10 min. 4-Ingredient Slow Cooker Ribbon Noodles Recipe Ingredients 1 1/2 lb lean beef top round stew meat, cut into 1- to 1 1/2-inch chunks 3 large yellow onions, thinly sliced 2 cups Pacific Foods organic unsalted beef broth 6 oz DeLallo whole wheat pappardelle or extra-wide egg noodles, dry Directions Place the sliced onions in the bottom of a 4- to 6-quart slow cooker. Spread the beef stew meat evenly over the onions. Pour the beef broth over the beef and onions. Cover and cook on LOW for 7 to 8 hours, or on HIGH for 4 to 5 hours, until the beef is very tender and the onions have softened into a savory sauce. Bring a large pot of water to a boil about 20 minutes before serving. Cook the ribbon noodles according to package directions until just al dente. Reserve 1/2 cup pasta water, then drain the noodles well. Stir the beef and onion mixture gently in the slow cooker. Add the hot drained noodles to the slow cooker. Toss gently until the noodles are coated with the beef and onion sauce. Add reserved pasta water, 1 to 2 tbsp at a time, only if the sauce needs loosening. Cover and let the noodles rest on WARM for 5 minutes before serving.
